default.note: Ubisoft ADS guide: vertical FOV equals the FOV option on PC and 60 deg on consoles. The PC slider range (commonly 60-90) and default were not verified. Horizontal = 2*atan(tan(v/2)*aspect), at 16:9 vertical 60 -> 91.5 deg, 90 -> 126.4 deg.
